description: A shell script for performance testing of Git object database operations, focusing on the impact of different fsync configurations on adding, stashing, unpacking, and committing files.

methods.name: populate_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of unique files across directories for testing.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository, makes an initial commit, and populates it with files.

methods.name: test_perf_fsync_cfgs
methods.description: Runs performance tests for various fsync configurations during different git operations.
